title: Length bound for formula encoding
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a CNF formula over variables indexed by the natural numbers, and let $N\in\mathbb N$. Suppose every literal in every clause of $\varphi$ has variable index less than $N$. If the cost of $\varphi$ is the sum, over its clauses $C$, of $|C|+1$, then the length of its binary encoding is at most $\operatorname{cost}(\varphi)(N+3)+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a CNF formula over natural-number-indexed variables
